question: What are the countries having confidence in national goverment higher than world average in 2022?
query: WITH avg_conf AS ( SELECT AVG(confidence_in_national_government) AS avg_conf FROM world_happiness_report WHERE year = 2022 ) SELECT country_name, confidence_in_national_government FROM world_happiness_report, avg_conf WHERE year = 2022 AND confidence_in_national_government > avg_conf ORDER BY confidence_in_national_government DESC LIMIT 50;
